# Blackwing Pearl Pencils, Balanced Japanese Graphite, Pink Finish, 12 Count
Brand: Blackwing
Category: Pencils > Wooden Lead Pencils

## Features
BALANCED AND SMOOTH - The Pearl's balanced Japanese graphite in a blush pink pearlescent lacquer. Dark enough for expressive lines, firm enough to hold a point through long journaling or drawing sessions.; A LEGEND SINCE THE 1930s - Loved by award-winning creators throughout history. Try out the pencils that were coveted by John Steinbeck, Chuck Jones, and more.; PREMIUM MATERIALS - Genuine California Incense-cedar barrel sharpens evenly and cleanly; premium Japanese graphite resists crumbling for a consistent line every time.; THE ICONIC RECTANGULAR ERASER - Blackwing's square ferrule and extendable, replaceable eraser have been its signature since the 1930s - instantly recognizable on any desk.; GIVES BACK TO THE ARTS - A portion of every purchase funds the Blackwing Foundation, supporting arts and music education in public schools. A meaningful gift for writers, artists, and musicians.

## Specifications
Ink Color: Black; Material Type: Aluminum, Cedar Wood, Graphite, Rubber; Line Size: 0_5mm; Additional Features: Dust Free Eraser, Ergonomic, Incense-cedar Wood, Premium Graphite; Writing Instrument Form: Graphite Pencil

## Description
Blackwing - Since the 1930s Tools Coveted By Award-winning Creators Pencils, sharpeners and notebooks for writers, artists, composers and anyone who does their best thinking with a pencil in hand. Genuine California Incense-cedar. Japanese graphite. The iconic ferrule that has been our signature for ninety years. Since the 1930s Built on Heritage Blackwing's roots go back to the 1930s, when it was the pencil of choice for creators including John Steinbeck and Chuck Jones. The brand disappeared in the 1990s and returned in 2010. Today Blackwing crafts pencils, notebooks and analog tools for people who want to slow down. Soft Graphite Darkest, Smoothest Core Dynamically reflects the pressure you apply. Blackwing's softest core, made for drawing. Balanced Graphite The Middle Ground Handles writing and sketching effortlessly. Made for journaling and music notation. Firm Graphite Half the Pressure Great point retention, yet buttery smooth. Made for writing and sketching. 1 Matte - Soft 2 Pearl - Balanced 3 602 - Firm One-Step Long Point Sharpener German steel blade, machined aluminum body, no plastic to crack. Creates the long curved point Blackwing pencils are designed around. Sharpeners Blackwing Notebooks Heavyweight pages made for graphite: clean lines, minimal ghosting, easy erasing. Lay-flat spiral or hardcover Slate. Notebooks Pencil Essentials Set One of each core, the One-Step sharpener and a point guard in a gift-ready box. The audition pack. Gift Sets Notebook Essentials Set Four pencils, the One-Step sharpener, a point guard and an A5 Slate notebook with a built-in pencil holster. Notebooks Find the Graphite That Matches How You Write Matte Add to Cart Pearl Add to Cart 602 Add to Cart Natural Add to Cart Pencil Essentials Set Add to Cart Customer Reviews 4.8 out of 5 stars 2,107 4.7 out of 5 stars 1,072 4.7 out of 5 stars 2,102 4.7 out of 5 stars 555 4.8 out of 5 stars 18 Price $34.00$34.00 $34.00$34.00 $34.00$34.00 $34.00$34.00 $50.00$50.00 Graphite Type Soft Balanced Firm Extra-Firm All four cores Line Darkness Darkest Dark Medium Lightest Full range Point Retention Shortest Medium Longer Longest Varies Recommended For Drawing Journaling, music notation Writing, sketching Technical drawing, notes Trying all four Barrel Finish Black Pearlescent white Gunmetal grey Clear matte cedar Assorted Eraser Color Black White Pink Grey Four colors California Incense-Cedar ✔ ✔ ✔ ✔ ✔ Count 12 12 12 12 4 + sharpener + guard I'm new to Blackwing. Which pencil should I start with? Most people start with the Pearl - it sits between the soft Matte and the firm 602. To try all four cores before committing to a dozen, the Pencil Essentials Set includes one of each. What do soft, firm, balanced and extra-firm actually mean? They describe how much graphite the pencil lays down and how long it holds a point. Softer cores make darker lines and need sharpening more often. Firmer cores make finer lines and last longer between sharpenings. Will Blackwing pencils fit a standard sharpener? Yes. The barrel is a standard pencil diameter. The Blackwing One-Step and Two-Step sharpeners are shaped to produce the long, curved point these pencils are designed around. Why is the eraser rectangular instead of round? The flat eraser slides out of the ferrule so you can extend it as it wears, then replace it when it is gone. It has been Blackwing's signature since the 1930s. What is the Blackwing Foundation? A portion of every purchase funds the Blackwing Foundation, which supports arts and music education in public schools.

# Blackwing Pearl Pencils - 12 Count, Pink Lacquer Finish, 2B Balanced Lead, Premium Wood, Japanese Graphite
Brand: Blackwing
Category: Pencils > Wooden Lead Pencils

## Features
PENCILS WITH HERITAGE – First created in the 1930’s, Blackwing built a following that included John Steinbeck and Chuck Jones, who proudly used Blackwings to create Bugs Bunny and many other Looney Tunes characters. Discontinued in the 90’s, devotees paid as much as $40 a pencil. In 2010, we revived the Blackwing brand for a new generation of writers, musicians, and others seeking a more natural existence.; PERFECT FOR ILLUSTRATORS AND CALLIGRAPHERS – With our balanced and smooth Japanese graphite core, Blackwing Pearl pencils are perfect for illustrators, UI/UX designers, and woodworkers. Use for a line that is softer than the Blackwing 602, but firmer than the Blackwing, and all without excessive sharpening.; UNIQUE ICONIC DESIGN – Blackwing’s unique and iconic rectangular erasers are synonymous with quality. Each of our pencils features a specially designed ferrule, allowing you to extend or replace the eraser.; COMMITMENT TO QUALITY – Blackwing Pearl pencils are made with the finest materials in the world, including Genuine Incense-cedar from California and premium Japanese graphite.; HOW WE GIVE BACK – A portion of the sales from all Blackwing products benefit the Blackwing Foundation, which funds and develops arts and music education at the K-12 level. Your purchase helps provide, among other things, the instruction, learning environment and instruments children need to participate in the Little Kids’ Rock Modern Band Program.; HELPING YOU SLOW DOWN – We believe that it's important and healthy to find balance in our increasingly digital lives. Our products encourage you to live creatively, intentionally, and mindfully.

## Specifications
